entries.title: Stable-DOM C/N/P species-local parent/daughter partition oracle
scientific_claims: within the qualified stable-DOM partition scope, each C/N/P daughter is derived from its same-species parent
for species X: X17=m*k*C_X*H, X19=(1-a)*X17 and X20=a*X17
the daughter pair conserves its parent exactly in the isolated partition identity
applicability: stable-DOM species-local partition represented by SYNQ-O004
same partition fraction a across the three species
no intended cross-species stoichiometric conversion at this partition step

expected_relation.comparison: decimal exact within the synthetic oracle representation

entries.units_contract: normalized species mass per area over interval, exactly as bounded by SYNQ-O004; no conversion to a broader ANIMO output unit is inferred

entries.title: Stable-DOM species permutation metamorphic oracle

explicit stoichiometric conversion relations are excluded
entries.units_contract: species-labelled mass relation; metamorphic comparison is unit-preserving

alternative_hypotheses_checked: cross-species similarity can be scientifically intentional rather than a defect
a TCD-specific diagnostic can appear reusable while merely encoding one historical typo
synthetic oracle success can be mistaken for whole-model or historical validation
NH4 and NO3 can exchange mass through reactions without becoming one species identity
stoichiometric relationships can require deliberate cross-species coupling
unit labels in examples can be confused with universal internal representation
disposition: promote only SYNQ-O004, SYNQ-O005 and the narrow PREP05 structural guard as qualified fragment entries
retain NH4/NO3, dimensional and broader stoichiometric contracts as candidates until executable adapters exist
retain reaction-wide ownership as an explicit GAP
do not infer whole-model validity, historical B2, TCD admission or production readiness
